{{Top}}
'''New Vertica''' was a region of the overly developed [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. New Vertica was often referred to as a [[City/Legends|city]], although it was in reality a part of the [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|moon-wide city]] that covered Nar Shaddaa. Over three hundred years before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the region declared independence from the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Kajidic/Legends|Kajidics]]. After a brief struggle, the Hutts decided to allow New Vertica to retain its independence, provided that it pay monthly tribute.<ref name="LoNH">''[[Lords of Nal Hutta]]''</ref>
